notes: VAT standard rate 21% (Law on VAT art. 2(32) and art. 19(1), VMI official text); jewellery is in neither reduced-rate list. Bullion EXEMPT under the investment-gold scheme (art. 112(1); definition art. 111). Silver is never mentioned in the law (21/21). Import duty 0%: EU Combined Nomenclature 2026 rates all HS 7108 lines 'Free'.
